• Juniper Labware newsletter ("Warehouse automation in 2026"): highlights this week's topic and links to the full article; readers on an active project can get matching case studies via a companion URL.
• Main article (blog.juniper.example/2026/warehouse): pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece (insights.juniper.example/warehouse/companion): the biggest saving from automation came from fewer mis-picks.
args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse Automation 2026 — Summary
